connection.description: Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Use the Share button on the sidebar to grant read-only or co-owner access to another user without revealing the password. Read-write mode (write/DML statements) is toggled from the connection's ⋯ menu.
connection.scopeLocalDesc: Queries dial the DB from your local machine. Required for hosts on 127.0.0.1 / your LAN.
connection.scopeRemoteDesc: Queries dial the DB from the team backend. Use for prod / staging behind VPN.
connection.scopeNote: The connection is saved to BOTH backends — credentials get encrypted with each BE's own key. Pick which one the toolbar Local/Remote toggle defaults to; you can flip per-query later from the toolbar.
connection.dsnTooltip: Connection-string mode lets you paste a full DSN with any params we don't surface (TLS certs, channel_binding, custom auth, etc.). The form fields below stay informational; the BE uses the string as-is.
connection.dsnKeepStored: (leave blank to keep the stored one)
connection.dsnNote: Stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). Host/Port/Database below are kept for the sidebar label only; Username and Password are used when the string has none. jdbc:postgresql:// strings work too.
connection.dbOptionalAll: (optional — leave blank to browse all databases)
connection.optionsHelp: Per-driver: Postgres family sslmode / application_name; MySQL family tls / allowNativePasswords; Mongo authSource / authMechanism / replicaSet.
connection.errDatabaseRequired: Database is required for SQL connections unless a custom connection string is provided
connection.errDsnEmpty: Connection string is empty — paste a DSN or switch back to form mode
connection.partialUpdate: Updated on {{ok}}; failed on {{missed}}. Retry from Edit to sync.
connection.partialCreate: Saved on {{ok}}; failed on {{missed}}. Edit + Save again to retry the missing side.
connection.duplicateDescription: Creates a new connection from “{{name}}”. The stored password is copied; sharing and read-write mode are not.
connection.errCopyUnsupported: This server can’t copy the stored password yet — enter the password to create the copy.
connection.copyPartial: Copied on {{ok}}. The {{missed}} server can’t copy stored passwords yet — duplicate there again once it’s updated.
connection.authSourceHelp: The database the user was created in — often admin.
connection.hostsHelpMongo: Several hosts (replica set): separate them with commas, e.g. db1,db2:27018,db3. A host without a port uses Port.
connection.mongoAuthHint: MongoDB checks the user name and password against the “{{db}}” database (Auth source). If the user was created in another database, enter that one in Auth source; otherwise the user name or password is wrong.
connection.mongoAuthHelp_scram: A MongoDB user (SCRAM; the server picks SHA-256 or SHA-1).
connection.mongoAuthHelp_ldap: An LDAP / Active Directory user, on MongoDB Enterprise or Atlas. The password is sent as is, so use it over TLS.
connection.mongoAuthHelp_aws: An IAM access key. Leave both blank to use the IAM role or AWS environment of the backend that runs the queries.
connection.mongoAuthHelp_none: For a server without access control.
connection.authSourceFellBack: Signed in through the “{{db}}” database, so Auth source is now set to it.
connection.mongoAuthHintBoth: MongoDB rejected the user name and password both in “{{db}}” and in “admin”. Check them, or enter the database the user was created in as Auth source.
connection.directFallback: The replica set announces its members as {{members}}, names this backend cannot resolve, so PatchMan connected straight to {{host}}. That works; for automatic failover, make those names resolvable here (DNS or /etc/hosts).
connection.directFallbackSecondary: {{host}} is not the primary, so only reads work.
connection.mongoDnsHint: The replica set's member names cannot be resolved from this backend. Add them to DNS or /etc/hosts, or enter just one host.

panel.noConnectionsHint: No connections yet. Add one from the Database sidebar tab.
panel.autoRerunTooltip: Re-runs the same query at a fixed interval — handy for live monitoring. Off by default. The icon turns green when enabled.
panel.schemaTooltip: Re-introspects tables & columns so autocomplete reflects the latest DB.
panel.rowLimitTooltip: Caps how many rows the BE returns. Empty = default ({{default}}).
panel.scopeLocalAvail: Run on this machine. Required for 127.0.0.1 / LAN DBs.
panel.scopeLocalUnavail: Not available — this connection wasn't written to the local BE. Edit + Save to retry.
panel.scopeRemoteAvail: Run on the PatchMan server. Consistent with teammates.
panel.scopeRemoteUnavail: Not available — this connection wasn't written to the team BE. Edit + Save to retry.
panel.scopeTooltip: Which backend runs this query — your local desktop BE or the team server. Mirrors the request-panel toggle.
panel.cancelTooltip: Aborts the running query on the BE.
panel.runTooltip: Executes against {{target}} via {{via}}. Read-only — writes rejected by the BE.
panel.beautifyTooltip: Reformats the editor text in place — SQL keywords upper-cased, clauses on their own lines; Mongo args pretty-printed. Shortcut: ⌘⇧F.
panel.examplesTooltip: Browse a cookbook of read-only query recipes (SQL + Mongo). Pick one to drop into the editor.
panel.saveQueryTooltip: Pins the current editor text under this connection in the sidebar. ⌘S.
panel.emptyRun: Press Cmd+Enter to run the query.
panel.emptyPickConnection: Pick a connection above to get started.

results.nextPage: Next page · only available when rows are truncated
results.largeBody: This result is <mono>{{rows}}</mono> rows × <mono>{{cols}}</mono> columns (<mono>{{cells}}</mono> cells). Rendering this many cells can slow the UI — exporting is usually faster and easier to work with.

table.sortTitle: Click to sort · Shift+click for multi-sort
table.noRowsBody: The query executed successfully but produced no columns or rows.
table.noRowsCauses: Common causes: empty collection, missing default database, or a typo in the collection/table name.
table.resizeTitle: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
table.pushWhereLike: Push as WHERE LIKE to the editor
table.noMatch: No rows match the current filters.

chart.noNumeric: No numeric columns found. Charts need at least one numeric column.
chart.label: Chart

jsonModal.invalidJson: This value isn't valid JSON — showing the raw text.

explain.fallback: EXPLAIN view didn't recognize a JSON plan. Try EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, ANALYZE) ... for Postgres.

save.title: Save query
save.description: Pin the current editor text under this connection so you can re-run it later from the sidebar.
save.moreTitle: Type to search the rest in the dropdown above
save.scopeLocalDesc: Stays in this browser. Works offline / without login.
save.scopeRemoteDesc: Syncs to your account; visible across devices.

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.description: Queries run as YOU — recipients use this connection without seeing the password. Pick a role per person: Read-only can run SELECT/find queries only; Co-owner gets full control (edit, re-share, delete, reveal the password, and run write statements when this connection's read-write mode is on).
share.coownerWarning: Co-owners have full control of this connection — including deleting it and revealing the password. Grant only to people you'd trust as a second owner.

examples.title: Query examples
examples.description: Read-only recipes you can drop into the editor. Pick a tab, search, then Use this to seed your query — or copy any snippet manually.
examples.filterPlaceholder: Filter by title, description, or tag…
examples.tip1: ⌘+Enter runs the query · ⌘+S saves it · Shift+click a column header for multi-column sort
examples.tip2: Use the Row limit field next to Run query to cap how many rows the BE returns (default 500).
examples.tip3: Right-click a cell for Copy / Copy as JSON / "Filter by this value" — pushes the WHERE clause back into the editor.

listRows.title: List rows
listRows.desc: Pull the first N rows of a table — fastest way to see what columns exist.

countRows.title: Count rows
countRows.desc: Just the count — useful when the result would be huge.

pickColumns.title: Pick specific columns
pickColumns.desc: Project only what you need — keeps the grid readable + speeds up wire transfer.

distinctValues.title: Distinct values
distinctValues.desc: Unique values of a column — quick sanity check on enum-like columns.

equalityIn.title: Equality + IN
equalityIn.desc: Limit rows by exact-match or set-of-values.

dateRange.title: Date range
dateRange.desc: Rows between two dates — replace the placeholders or use {{var}} for env templating.

nullHandling.title: NULL handling
nullHandling.desc: Find rows missing (or having) a value.

groupByCount.title: GROUP BY + COUNT
groupByCount.desc: Rollup by a category column — the canonical "rows per status" report.

sumAvg.title: SUM / AVG / MIN / MAX
sumAvg.desc: Numeric rollups on a money column, with a HAVING filter.

dailySeries.title: Daily series (date_trunc)
dailySeries.desc: Bucket rows into days for a time-series chart.

innerJoin.title: INNER JOIN
innerJoin.desc: Combine related tables — orders + customer fields.

leftJoin.title: LEFT JOIN with optional side
leftJoin.desc: Include rows from the left table even if the right side is missing.

cte.title: CTE (WITH …)
cte.desc: Break a complex query into named steps for readability.

rowNumber.title: ROW_NUMBER() per group
rowNumber.desc: Number rows within each user — first order per user, etc.

cumulativeSum.title: Cumulative SUM
cumulativeSum.desc: Running total of revenue per day.

extractField.title: Extract a field
extractField.desc: `->>` reads a top-level key as text. Add a cast for numerics.

filterJson.title: Filter inside JSON
filterJson.desc: Match a value nested inside a JSON path.

explainAnalyze.title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE
explainAnalyze.desc: See how the planner thinks about your query — surfaced as a tree in the Plan view.

listColumns.title: List columns of a table
listColumns.desc: When the sidebar autocomplete isn't enough — full information_schema dump.

envVars.title: Environment variables
envVars.desc: {{var}} placeholders are filled from the params bar above the editor.

multiStatement.title: Multi-statement (returns N result tabs)
multiStatement.desc: Run several statements in one go — each gets its own result tab.

currentDb.title: Current DB · collection · find
currentDb.desc: Uses the connection's default database. Easiest form.

quotedCollection.title: Quoted collection name
quotedCollection.desc: Use getCollection for names with dots, dashes, spaces.

switchDb.title: Switch to another database
switchDb.desc: getSiblingDB hops to the named DB on the same client.

crossDb.title: Cross-DB shorthand
crossDb.desc: db.<dbname>.<collection>.<op>(...) — same as getSiblingDB, three dots.

crossDbQuoted.title: Cross-DB + quoted collection
crossDbQuoted.desc: Both at once — most explicit, always works.

equalityProjection.title: Equality + projection
equalityProjection.desc: Find by a single field. Second arg picks which fields come back.

inNin.title: IN / NIN sets
inNin.desc: $in matches one of N values. Nice for status-style enums.

fieldExists.title: Field exists
fieldExists.desc: $exists differentiates missing field from null value.

arrayMatch.title: Array element match
arrayMatch.desc: Find docs whose array contains a given element.

limitSkipSort.title: Limit + skip + sort
limitSkipSort.desc: Pagination + ordering, exactly the way the Mongo shell does it.

countFetch.title: Count instead of fetch
countFetch.desc: .count() short-circuits to countDocuments under the hood.

groupSum.title: Group + sum (revenue per user)
groupSum.desc: Top-revenue users in a single pipeline.

unwind.title: Unwind array + group
unwind.desc: Flatten an embedded array and roll it up.

dailySeries.title: Daily series (date bucketing)
dailySeries.desc: Group documents by day — handy for charts.

lookup.title: Lookup (left join)
lookup.desc: Join orders with users on userId. Mongo's "JOIN".

countDocuments.title: countDocuments
countDocuments.desc: Accurate count that respects the filter — slower on huge collections.

estimatedDocumentCount.title: estimatedDocumentCount
estimatedDocumentCount.desc: Fast metadata-driven count — does not accept a filter.

findOne.title: findOne
findOne.desc: Pull a single matching doc — useful when you only need one example.

explainQuery.title: Explain a query
explainQuery.desc: See whether an index is used + scan stats.

sidebar.savedLocalTip: Saved on this device — stays in this browser.
sidebar.savedRemoteTip: Synced to your account — visible across devices.
sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and every saved query / grant under it are removed. Active query tabs against this connection will fail their next run. This cannot be undone.
sidebar.toastModeFailDesc: Every backend rejected the change. Check your access and try again.
sidebar.scopeBoth: Stored on both backends. Toolbar Local/Remote toggle flips the runner per query.
sidebar.scopeLocalOnly: Only on this device — the PatchMan server didn't accept the last write.
sidebar.scopeRemoteOnly: Only on the PatchMan server — this device didn't accept the last write.
